import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 202;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[][] edge_flow = new int[MAX_NODES][MAX_NODES];
    static int[][] edge_capacity = new int[MAX_NODES][MAX_NODES];
    static int[] parent_arr = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] q_arr = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] dist_arr = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static int computeMaxFlow(int numNodes, int src, int dest) {
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(parent_arr, -1);
            dist_arr[src] = INF;
            int qhead = 0, qtail = 0;
            q_arr[qtail++] = src;
            while (qhead < qtail && parent_arr[dest] < 0) {
                int curr = q_arr[qhead++];
                for (int next = 0; next < numNodes; ++next) {
                    if (parent_arr[next] < 0) {
                        int residual = edge_capacity[curr][next] - edge_flow[curr][next];
                        if (residual > 0) {
                            parent_arr[q_arr[qtail] = next] = curr;
                            dist_arr[next] = Math.min(dist_arr[curr], residual);
                            qtail++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent_arr[dest] < 0) break;
            int flow_push = dist_arr[dest];
            for (int nd = dest; nd != src; nd = parent_arr[nd]) {
                edge_flow[parent_arr[nd]][nd] += flow_push;
                edge_flow[nd][parent_arr[nd]] -= flow_push;
            }
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int nd = 0; nd < numNodes; ++nd)
            total += edge_flow[src][nd];
        return total;
    }

    static char[][] input_grid = new char[11][11];
    static char[][] output_grid = new char[11][11];
    static int zombie_x, zombie_y;
    static int[] drow = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[] dcol = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[][] dist_map = new int[101][101];
    static int gridSize, timeBound;
    static List<Integer> outRows = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> outCols = new ArrayList<>();

    static void runBFS(int sx, int sy, int[] resultDist, boolean requiresCheck) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        resultDist[sx * gridSize + sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0];
            int c = cell[1];
            int idx = r * gridSize + c;
            int d = resultDist[idx];
            if (requiresCheck) {
                if (dist_map[zombie_x * gridSize + zombie_y][idx] <= d || timeBound <= d) {
                    if (dist_map[zombie_x * gridSize + zombie_y][idx] < d || timeBound < d)
                        resultDist[idx] = INF + 1;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + drow[k], nc = c + dcol[k];
                if (nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr == gridSize || nc == gridSize) continue;
                char ch = output_grid[nr][nc];
                if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') continue;
                int nidx = nr * gridSize + nc;
                if (resultDist[nidx] != INF) continue;
                resultDist[nidx] = d + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    static void constructNetwork() {
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                char val = output_grid[i][j];
                if (val >= '1' && val <= '9') {
                    outRows.add(i);
                    outCols.add(j);
                    int idx = i * gridSize + j;
                    edge_capacity[idx + 2 + gridSize * gridSize][1] = val - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        int zIdx = zombie_x * gridSize + zombie_y;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                char val = input_grid[i][j];
                if (val >= '1' && val <= '9') {
                    int idx = i * gridSize + j;
                    edge_capacity[0][idx + 2] = val - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < outRows.size(); ++k) {
                        int r = outRows.get(k), c = outCols.get(k);
                        int qIdx = r * gridSize + c;
                        if (dist_map[idx][qIdx] < INF)
                            edge_capacity[idx + 2][qIdx + 2 + gridSize * gridSize] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        gridSize = sc.nextInt();
        timeBound = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_map[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            input_grid[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            output_grid[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        
        zombie_x = -1;
        zombie_y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                if (input_grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zombie_x = i;
                    zombie_y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        runBFS(zombie_x, zombie_y, dist_map[zombie_x * gridSize + zombie_y], false);
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                if (input_grid[i][j] >= '1' && input_grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    runBFS(i, j, dist_map[i * gridSize + j], true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        constructNetwork();
        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow(2 + gridSize * gridSize + gridSize * gridSize, 0, 1));
    }
}
